title: Preserve test-integrity evidence in immutable per-change records with a validated index
description: Owner795de3fc observes repeated independent additive docs/TEST_INTEGRITY.md prepend merge conflicts in Runtime/Kernel convergence, requiring lossless peer reconciliation. Propose ONE bounded QA-led evidence organization change with Work Integration validation/discovery consent. Design immutable per-task/change integrity records and discoverable gate-validated index, preserving all historical notes, IDs, strict scenarios, hashes and original QA ownership. No immediate migration, current merge-protocol bypass, assertion weakening, acceptance shortcut or provider start. Existing frozen candidates must still reconcile notes under QA consent; this proposal remains unassigned until reliability sequence and peer review.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task/change integrity record has immutable identity and provenance, required machine-readable fields and scenario/spec references; later corrections append new evidence rather than overwrite historical truth.
Discovery/index validation rejects missing, malformed, duplicated, stale or unauthorized records and preserves strict Test Integrity Note requirements for test changes.

Migration or compatibility plan preserves every historical docs/TEST_INTEGRITY.md note byte-for-byte or with lossless proven source/hash mapping; no deleting old evidence or changing acceptance expectations.

Concurrent additive independent records merge without repeated monolithic prepend conflicts; deterministic boundary scenarios prove discovery and fail-closed validation under missing/conflicting index entries.
QA explicitly consents to record and scenario paths; Work Integration consents to gate/discovery paths; source ownership, named approvals and all exact-commit checks remain enforced.
No rollout or frozen-candidate protocol change occurs from proposal alone; independent QA acceptance and guarded integration required for eventual implementation.
